description: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) of different model configurations as a function of TFLOPs, with the x-axis representing TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8 and the y-axis representing Loss Ratio (%) on a linear scale from 94 to 100. The plot contains four lines: a purple line with purple diamond markers representing 'Vanilla', an orange line with orange circle markers representing 'SepLLM (n=64)', a blue line with blue cross markers representing 'SepLLM (n=128)', and a green line with green diamond markers representing 'SepLLM (n=64, H)'. Additionally, a red line with red circle markers represents 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)'. The 'Vanilla' model maintains a loss ratio of approximately 100% across the entire TFLOPs range. The 'SepLLM (n=64)' model starts at a loss ratio of approximately 98.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to approximately 100% by 4e8 TFLOPs. The 'SepLLM (n=128)' model begins at approximately 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to approximately 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' model starts at approximately 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to approximately 99.9% at 4e8 TFLOPs, and then slightly declines to approximately 99.7% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The 'SepLLM (n=64, H/T)' model begins at 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to approximately 99.5% at 4e8 TFLOPs, and then declines to approximately 99.1% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
